question: Which offices of the union may read the injured-person, injury, treatment, witness, investigation and compensation-claim fields of a workplace incident, the reporter and assignee fields of a hazard report and the issuance records of PPE, and does any member below the health and safety representative floor read an incident or a hazard report by id?
decision: Individual injury/treatment/witness/WSIB claim details are restricted to designated health-and-safety case handlers and specifically mandated officers on a need-to-know basis, plus authorized external representatives only by case grant and member permission where required. Members may read their own identified submissions and workplace hazard summaries redacted of personal details; anonymous reporters use a separate receipt capability rather than identity linkage. By-ID and list share the same authorization and field projections; every sensitive read/export is audited.
originalProposedDecision: Injured-person, injury, treatment, witness, investigation and claim fields: health and safety reps, officers and admins only. By-id routes use the same floor as collections. Members read only reports they filed and a redacted summary of hazards at their own worksite. Reads of incident detail are audited.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
